features.name: Scenario navigation list
features.description: A left-hand navigation list exposes the three scenarios ('1) Conversion', '2) Prediction', '3) ReverseConversion') and switches the content frame when a scenario is selected.
expected_behaviour: All three scenario items are visible in the nav list with their verbatim '1) '/'2) '/'3) ' prefixes
Selecting a scenario swaps the content area to that scenario's page (distinct sample header)

features.name: Conversion - Create Generator
features.description: Scenario 1 shows the 'TextConversionGenerator Sample' header, a 'Set a language tag' TextBox (langTag) and a 'Create Generator' button. Clicking Create Generator instantiates a TextConversionGenerator for the entered language tag and reports status.
expected_behaviour: langTag TextBox and 'Create Generator' button are present
Clicking Create Generator with an unsupported/empty tag shows 'Unsupported language.' and keeps the operation area collapsed
Clicking Create Generator with a valid installed language shows 'Successfully instantiated a generator.' and reveals the operation area (Execute, Input, method combo, Result)

features.name: Conversion - Execute (candidates)
features.description: After a generator is created, the Execute button (inside GeneratorOperationArea, Visibility=Collapsed until success) calls GetCandidatesAsync and lists conversion candidates in resultView, or reports 'No candidates.'
expected_behaviour: Execute button and Input box are hidden until a generator is successfully created (by design, matches UWP)
With a generator and non-empty Input, Execute populates resultView with candidates or shows 'No candidates.'

features.name: Prediction - Create Generator
features.description: Scenario 2 shows the 'TextPredictionGenerator Sample' header and creates a TextPredictionGenerator, revealing the operation area on success.
expected_behaviour: Clicking Create Generator reports 'Successfully instantiated a generator.' and reveals Execute/Input/method combo/Result

features.name: Prediction - Execute (candidates)
features.description: Execute calls the prediction API for the Input text and lists candidates in resultView, or reports 'No candidates.'
expected_behaviour: With a generator and Input text, Execute runs the prediction handler
resultView is populated with candidates or status shows 'No candidates.'

features.name: ReverseConversion - Create Generator
features.description: Scenario 3 shows the 'TextReverseConversionGenerator Sample' header and creates a TextReverseConversionGenerator, revealing the operation area on success.
expected_behaviour: Clicking Create Generator with an unsupported/empty tag shows 'Unsupported language.' and keeps the operation area collapsed
With a valid language it reports success and reveals Execute/Input/Result

features.name: ReverseConversion - Execute (candidates)
features.description: Execute calls the reverse-conversion API for the Input text and lists candidates in resultView, or reports 'No candidates.'
expected_behaviour: Execute button hidden until generator created (by design)
With a generator and Input, Execute runs the reverse-conversion handler and updates resultView/status

features.name: Status notification area
features.description: A shared StatusBlock at the bottom reports operation results ('Unsupported language.', 'Successfully instantiated a generator.', 'No candidates.') via NotifyUser.
expected_behaviour: Status messages appear after Create Generator / Execute actions
Message text matches the code path taken (success vs error vs no candidates)
